quirks: No input schema was published — the org-enrich endpoint REQUIRES a ?domain= query string param (the company's web domain, e.g. domain=stripe.com). Without it the call would not return a useful org.
All data is nested under body.organization, not at the top level.
Despite being GET, it is a paid x402 endpoint ($0.01 USDC on Base); the payment is for the lookup, not a body.
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.orth.sh/apollo/api/v1/organizations/enrich with a single query param ?domain=<company web domain> (e.g. stripe.com). It is an x402 paid endpoint ($0.01 USDC on Base, no API key, no request body). The response is JSON with the full Apollo organization profile nested under body.organization — read fields like body.organization.name, .industry, .estimated_num_employees, .annual_revenue, .founded_year, and .linkedin_url. Synchronous; the result comes back in one call.
